Help & policies

Terms of use

Using the hosted planner and its Pro subscription.

Educational use

Retirement Forecast is an educational U.S. retirement scenario planner operated by Robert Soliday. Results are hypothetical and depend on your inputs and simplified model assumptions. They are not predictions, guarantees, or individualized financial, investment, tax, legal, or insurance advice. Read the model scope and limitations and verify inputs before using results.

A four-path preview illustrates sample outcomes and is too small to estimate retirement readiness. A larger run reduces sampling noise but does not make assumptions accurate or guarantee future outcomes.

Pro subscriptions

The listed plans are $9.99 per month or $79 per year in U.S. dollars. Stripe Checkout shows the amount, billing interval, and any applicable taxes before you pay. Subscriptions renew automatically at the selected interval until canceled.

Pro provides up to 10,000 paths per full simulation and planning-target searches while your subscription is active. Calculations run on your device. Pro access is linked to the account used to subscribe; it does not include cloud storage or synchronization of your scenarios.

Use Plans & billing → Manage billing to manage billing or cancel through Stripe. Review the effective date shown in the portal. Signing out or deleting browser data does not cancel billing. If the portal is unavailable, contact support for help.

Cancellation does not automatically refund prior charges. Refund requests are reviewed individually, without a guarantee of approval. Any rights that apply by law remain unaffected.

Your account and saved plans

Protect your sign-in accounts and exported files. Scenarios are stored in the current browser, and support cannot restore cleared plans without a backup. Export JSON before clearing browser data or replacing plans with an import. See the privacy notice for data handling.

Availability and responsible use

Browser support, network availability, and third-party services can affect access. Features and model assumptions may be updated, and uninterrupted or error-free operation is not guaranteed. Do not interfere with the service, attempt to access other users’ accounts, or use it unlawfully. Contact support if a problem prevents use of a paid subscription.

These terms describe use of the hosted planner. Copying or redistributing its software and content is governed separately by the code license.

Questions

Email rtsoliday@gmail.com for help with these terms, a subscription, or a privacy request.
